blocked_sentences: • Fight! — This creature fights up to one target creature an opponent controls

needs.what: a target owned by one mode of a top-level choose_mode (here a random one on a Saga chapter ability) that is 'up to one' -- the mode may be chosen, including at random, with zero targets declared, and the controller may decline the target when one exists; then 'This creature fights' with nothing does nothing
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Target specs with 'mode' are refused by _check_mode_targets in cards/loader/targets.py if 'optional' or variable-size ('declining it is declining the mode'). A fixed count:1 mode target changes the card twice: the controller is forced to fight when an opponent has a creature, and with no opposing creature the Fight mode is struck from the random pool (pick_at_random only offers modes with legal targets), skewing the odds toward the other two modes. A card-level (non-mode) optional target cannot share the card with mode-owned targets, and the other two modes' 'target creature' needs mode-owned targets
